## Evidence

- [ ] Tests run locally: command and result
- [ ] CI log read for the test count (not the badge alone)
- [ ] Failure paths tested, not only the success path

## Safety
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private data added
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason is stated
- [ ] No change to workflow permissions, or the reason is stated
- [ ] Untrusted text (issues, comments, files) is treated as data, not instructions
